```{python}
#| label: fig-guard-rings
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Guard rings for latch-up prevention (layout top view): the NMOS is surrounded by a grounded $p^+$ guard ring, the PMOS by an $n^+$ guard ring tied to $V_\\mathrm{DD}$ inside the n-well. The rings collect injected minority and majority carriers before they can act as base current for the parasitic bipolar transistors."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pyutil import laygen as lg
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle


def ring(ax, x, y, w, h, t, layer):
    lg.rect(ax, layer, x, y, w, t)             # bottom
    lg.rect(ax, layer, x, y + h - t, w, t)     # top
    lg.rect(ax, layer, x, y, t, h)             # left
    lg.rect(ax, layer, x + w - t, y, t, h)     # right


fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.4))

# NMOS side: p+ guard ring (RX + BP)
ring(ax, 0.0, 0.0, 6.0, 6.0, 0.55, 'BP')
ring(ax, 0.1, 0.1, 5.8, 5.8, 0.35, 'RX')
lg.rect(ax, 'RX', 1.5, 1.8, 3.0, 2.2)
lg.rect(ax, 'PC', 2.75, 1.2, 0.5, 3.4)
ax.text(3.0, 6.4, 'NMOS with $p^+$ guard ring ($V_\\mathrm{SS}$)',
        fontsize=9, ha='center')

# PMOS side: n-well with n+ guard ring
lg.rect(ax, 'NW', 7.6, -0.5, 7.0, 7.0)
ring(ax, 8.2, 0.0, 6.0, 6.0, 0.55, 'RX')
lg.rect(ax, 'BP', 9.4, 1.5, 3.6, 2.8)
lg.rect(ax, 'RX', 9.7, 1.8, 3.0, 2.2)
lg.rect(ax, 'PC', 10.95, 1.2, 0.5, 3.4)
ax.text(11.2, 6.7, 'PMOS with $n^+$ guard ring ($V_\\mathrm{DD}$)\nin the n-well',
        fontsize=9, ha='center')

lg.legend(ax, ['NW', 'RX', 'PC', 'BP'], loc='center right')
lg.finish(ax, (-0.5, 18.0), (-1.0, 7.6))
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
